topic: Reporting a Lost Phone at the Mall Information Desk

script.title: LOST PHONE AT MALL
script.scene_zh: 商場服務台 · 尋找手機
script.story_hook: One taco lunch, one missing phone.
script.intro_zh: 一頓塔可午餐，一支消失的手機。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the mall info desk. Listen for lost-item rescue phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到商場服務台。留意失物尋找相關的實用說法。
script.outro: And that's one phone case on its way. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 一樁手機失物案就這樣有了轉機。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now, repeat every line out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，每一句都大聲跟讀一遍。
script.title_quote: the very loud baby of malls
script.char_a_description: an anxious young woman in her early twenties with wavy auburn hair in a loose braid over one shoulder, small gold hoop earrings, a denim overall dress, a canvas shoulder bag, and a slight build
script.char_b_description: a senior woman in her sixties with very short white curly hair, large rectangular glasses, a deep blue mall info vest full of badges, pearl earrings, a reading chain around her neck, and a straight tall build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry, I lost my phone somewhere today.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈsɑɹi aɪ lɔst maɪ foʊn ˈsəmˌwɛɹ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，不好意思，我今天不知在哪裡弄丟了手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh my, okay, take a breath. When did it happen?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ maɪ oʊˈkeɪ teɪk ə bɹɛθ wɛn dɪd ɪt həˈpænd/
dialogue.zh: 天啊，好，先深呼吸。是什麼時候發現不見的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Probably today, sometime after one o'clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɹɑbəbli təˈdeɪ ˈsʌmˌtaɪm ˈæftɚ wʌn əˈklɑk/
dialogue.zh: 大概是今天，一點鐘之後的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, last place you saw it alive?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ læst pleɪs ju sɔ ɪt əˈlaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 好，最後一次看到它還在運作是在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The food court, um, I ate tacos there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fud kɔɹt ʌm aɪ eɪt ˈtɑkəz ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 美食街，嗯，我在那裡吃了塔可。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Table number or just the general area?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ˈteɪbəl ˈnʌmbɚ ɔɹ dʒʌst ðə ˈdʒɛnɚəl ˈɛɹiə/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。是幾號桌，還是大概哪個區域？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A round table by the window, left of the fountain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɹaʊnd ˈteɪbəl baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ lɛft əv ðə ˈfaʊnɾɪn/
dialogue.zh: 靠窗的一張圓桌，在噴水池的左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pink fountain, the very loud baby of malls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɪŋk ˈfaʊnɾɪn ðə ˈvɛɹi laʊd ˈbeɪbi əv mɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 那個粉紅噴水池，商場裡嗓門最大的小寶寶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, sadly yes, it is my nemesis today.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈsædli jɛs ɪt ɪz maɪ nɪˈmesəs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，很可惜是的，今天它是我的頭號冤家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First thing, can you call it right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst θɪŋ kən ju kɔl ɪt ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 第一件事，你現在可以撥自己的號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can, but from whose phone? I have nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən bʌt fɹəm huz foʊn aɪ hæv ˈnʌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，可是要用誰的手機打？我身上什麼都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My desk phone, speaker, give it a try.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dɛsk foʊn ˈspikɚ ɡɪv ɪt ə tɹaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 用我櫃台的電話，開擴音，試試看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ring, ring... um, nothing, straight to voicemail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪŋ ɹɪŋ ʌm ˈnʌθɪŋ stɹeɪt tə ˈvɔɪsmeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 嘟……嘟……嗯，沒接，直接轉到語音信箱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good news, it still rings, so it's on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd nuz ɪt stɪl ɹɪŋz soʊ ɪts ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 好消息，它還會響，代表手機還有電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please say that again, I needed to hear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz seɪ ðæt əˈɡɛn aɪ ˈnidɪd tə hɪɹ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 拜託把這句話再說一遍，我太需要聽見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I say it all day, phones hide, phones return.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪ ɪt ɔl deɪ foʊnz haɪd foʊnz ɹɪˈtɝn/
dialogue.zh: 我整天都在說這句：手機會躲起來，也會回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a lost and found bin here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə lɔst ænd faʊnd bɪn hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡有失物招領箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, locked cabinet, items wait two weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du lɑkt ˈkæbənət ˈaɪɾəmz weɪt tu wikz/
dialogue.zh: 有的，會鎖起來，物品在那裡等兩週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks, good, we drive back on Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wikz ɡʊd wi dɹaɪv bæk ɑn ˈsʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 兩週剛好，我們週日才會開車回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you're fine, don't panic yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jʊɹ faɪn doʊnt ˈpænɪk jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 那你就還有時間，先別慌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy for you to say, Captain Calm Desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi fɚ ju tə seɪ ˈkæptən kɑm dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 你坐在穩如泰山的櫃台後面，當然講得輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Guilty as charged. Now, was anyone near it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɪlti æz ˈtʃɑɹdʒd naʊ wəz ˈɛniˌwʌn nɪɹ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我認罪。那麼，手機附近有沒有人？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, a kid looked at me, about seven years old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ə kɪd lʊkt æt mi əˈbaʊt ˈsɛvən jɪɹz oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，有個小孩看過我幾眼，大約七歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That age helps, little kids collect cool things.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt eɪdʒ hɛps ˈlɪɾəl kɪdz kəˈlɛkt kul θɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 那個年齡正好，小朋友最喜歡收集酷東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, he was eyeing my glow phone case.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hi wəz ˈaɪɪŋ maɪ ɡloʊ foʊn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，他一直在盯我的手機殼，會發光的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, that changes the story a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæt ˈtʃeɪndʒəz ðə ˈstɔɹi ə ˈlɪɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那故事就有點不一樣的走向了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that bad? Should I talk to his parent?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt bæd ʃʊd aɪ tɔk tə hɪz ˈpɛɹənt/
dialogue.zh: 這算壞事嗎？我需要去跟他家長談嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, we ask nicely, no accusations, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt wi æsk ˈnaɪsli noʊ əˌkjuzəˈteɪʃənz ˈpɹɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 先不用，我們只禮貌詢問，不亂指控，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, relief. What else can I do right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɹɪˈlif wʌt ɛls kən aɪ du ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，鬆口氣了。現在我還能做些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From any device, lock the phone remotely.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹəm ˈɛni dɪˈvaɪs lɑk ðə foʊn ɹɪˈmoʊtli/
dialogue.zh: 用任何一台裝置，都可以遠端把手機鎖住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, my sister has the app for that, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm maɪ ˈsɪstɚ hæz ði æp fɚ ðæt aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我姊那裡有那種定位應用程式，我記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, have her track it while you are here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt hæv hɚ tɹæk ɪt waɪl ju ɑɹ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，趁你在這裡，請她幫忙定位看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, wait, one more thing, my bank app too.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ weɪt wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ maɪ bæŋk æp tu/
dialogue.zh: 噢，等等，還有一件事，我手機裡也有銀行軟體。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart catch. Do you want a printed note here?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt kæʃ du ju wɑnt ə ˈpɹɪnɾɪd noʊt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 想得周到。要在櫃台幫你立一張書面紀錄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, um, then what do I do with that paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʌm ðɛn wʌt du aɪ du wɪð ðæt ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 要，嗯，那那張紙我之後要拿去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, it proves you reported it today.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ɪt pɹuːvz ju ɹɪˈpoɾɾɪd ɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 收好，它證明你今天有來登記過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoa, the busiest phone rescue day ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /woʊ ðə ˈbɪziəst foʊn ˈɹɛsˌkjuz deɪ ˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，這是我經歷過最忙碌的手機救援日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll put that on the official record.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl pʊt ðæt ɑn ði əˈfɪʃəl ˈɹɛkɚd/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我會把這句放進正式紀錄裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I borrow a phone? Just three quick calls.
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ ˈbɛɹoʊ ə foʊn dʒʌst θɹi kwɪk kɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 我能借一支電話嗎？只要三通很快的通話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, landline only, it lives right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ˈlændˌlaɪn ˈoʊnli ɪt lɪvz ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，只有市話，它就住在這個桌面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Call her now, she can track in minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt kɔl hɚ naʊ ʃi kən tɹæk ɪn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我現在打給她，她幾分鐘就能定位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dial away, take your time, it's quiet here.
dialogue.phonetic: /daɪl əˈweɪ teɪk jɔɹ taɪm ɪts ˈkwaɪət hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你慢慢撥，不用趕時間，這裡很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's on, um, the pin shows the second floor!
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz ɑn ʌm ðə pɪn ʃoʊz ðə ˈsɛkənd flɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 她接上了，嗯，定位點顯示在二樓！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second floor has arcade and the returns desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd flɔɹ hæz ɑɹˈkeɪd ænd ðə ɹɪˈtɝnz dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 二樓有電玩區，還有退貨櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The arcade... um, did a kid play with it there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɑɹˈkeɪd ʌm dɪd ə kɪd pleɪ wɪð ɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 電玩區……嗯，難道剛剛有小孩在那裡玩我的手機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth checking, I'll walk you up, five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɝθ ˈtʃɛkɪŋ aɪl wɔk ju ʌp faɪv ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 值得上去確認，我陪你上樓，五分鐘路程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You'd leave the desk to walk me upstairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /jud liːv ðə dɛsk tə wɔk mi ˌʌpˈstɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 你願意離開櫃台，陪我上二樓嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lost phone emergencies? This is my sport.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔst foʊn ɪˈmɝdʒənsiz ðɪs ɪz maɪ spɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 手機失蹤這種緊急事件，正是我的強項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, you're a legend, honestly, mall hero.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ jʊɹ ə ˈlɛdʒənd ˈɑnəstli mɔl ˈhɪɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，你根本是傳說人物，說真的，商場英雄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow, walk with me, let's go meet that pin.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ wɔk wɪð mi lɛts ɡoʊ mit ðæt pɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我們慢慢走，跟著我，去會合那個定位點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal! Oh, should I keep this note too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil oʊ ʃʊd aɪ kip ðɪs noʊt tu/
dialogue.zh: 成交！噢，那這張書面紀錄我也要留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the number's on it, that's important.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈnʌmbɚz ɑn ɪt ðæts ɪmˈpɔɹtənt/
dialogue.zh: 要的，登記號碼就在上面，那個很重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You gave me a case number? Wow, official.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡeɪv mi ə keɪs ˈnʌmbɚ waʊ əˈfɪʃəl/
dialogue.zh: 你已經給我案件編號了？哇，好正式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full service, phone lock, case, and escort.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl ˈsɝvəs foʊn lɑk keɪs ænd ˈɛskɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 全套服務：鎖機、登記案件，還有專人護送。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You people are amazing, I'll say it loudly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈpipəl ɑɹ əˈmeɪzɪŋ aɪl seɪ ɪt ˈlaʊdli/
dialogue.zh: 你們真的太厲害了，我要大聲說出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loudly noted. Now, up we go, second floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaʊdli ˈnoʊɾɪd naʊ ʌp wi ɡoʊ ˈsɛkənd flɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 大聲記下了。來，我們上二樓囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for staying calm beside me.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɚ ˈsteɪɪŋ kɑm bɪˈsaɪd mi/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你一路冷靜地陪在我身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the job, half of it is calm theater.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə dʒɑb hæf əv ɪt ɪz kɑm ˈθɪətɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這就是這份工作，有一半是冷靜的表演。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! After you then, my new friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ æfɾɚ ju ðɛn maɪ nju fɹɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，那妳先請，我的新朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phones hide, phones return. Second floor, let's go.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊnz haɪd foʊnz ɹɪˈtɝn ˈsɛkənd flɔɹ lɛts ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 手機會躲起來，也會回家。二樓，出發囉。

script.youtube_title: 【手機在商場弄丟了📱】「商場裡嗓門最大的小寶寶」尋回手機全程🛍️🎧｜聽完就會報失物｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Finding a Lost Phone at the Mall
script.youtube_title_en: "The Very Loud Baby of Malls" — Reporting a Lost Phone at the Info Desk
script.youtube_description:
「商場裡嗓門最大的小寶寶」——在手機消失的當下，服務台能幫你多少？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在商場一樓的資訊服務台。

你會聽到：說清最後看見手機的地點；用櫃台電話擴音撥自己號碼；認識失物招領箱與兩週保管期；請家人遠端定位、鎖機；請服務台立書面紀錄、拿登記號碼，最後一起上二樓追查。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿美國人面對突發狀況的真實語感：um、oh、well、whoa、ha。聽完你就會用：I lost my...、last place you saw it、straight to voicemail、lock the phone remotely、walk you up。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜別忘了訂閱並打開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The very loud baby of malls" — what do you do at the mall info desk when your phone disappears? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at a shopping mall information counter.

You will hear: describing where the phone was last seen, calling your own number on speaker, learning the lost-and-found rules and the two-week hold, asking a sister to track and lock the phone remotely, getting a printed report with a case number, and walking up to the second floor together.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real spoken texture: um, oh, well, whoa, ha. By the end you'll own phrases like I lost my..., straight to voicemail, and Worth checking.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.
